senses.gloss: ch. same (neut. verb) to be burnt, blackened.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 30:30">Targ. Job XXX, 30</cite> (h. text <he>חרה</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 6:29">Targ. Jer. VI, 29</cite> <cite ref="H01678"><he>חֲרֵיךְ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 9:18">Targ. Is. IX, 18</cite> <cite ref="H01625"><he>חֲרוֹכַת</he></cite> (ed. Lag. <he>חרובת</he>).
<cite ref="Pesachim 40a:2">Pes. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>לא לִיחֲרוֹךְ וכ׳</he> one must not roast two ears &c.—Part. pass. <cite ref="H01678"><he>חֲרִיךְ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 85a:22">B. Mets. 85ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 46a:1">Ber. 46ᵃ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="H01625"><he>חֲרוֹכָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 41a:4">Kidd. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>מְחָרֵיךְ רישא</he> he himself singed the hair off the animal’s head (in preparing for the Sabbath).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 21:15">Targ. Y. Gen. XXI, 15</cite> <he>אתח׳</he> he was parched (with fever).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 12:37">Targ. Y. Ex. XII, 37</cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 85a:22">B. Mets. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>אִיחַרְכוּ שקיה</he> (Ar. <he>חרכו</he>) his legs were burnt.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 74a:5">B. Bath. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>אִיחֲרַךְ אִיחֲרוּכֵי</he> Ms. M. 2 (ed. … <he>הוה איח׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) it (the wool) was singed.
<cite ref="Niddah 28a">Nidd. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>איחרך אִיחֲרוּכֵי</he> Rashi (ed. <he>איחרכי</he>, corr. acc.) it (the corpse) was charred (not burnt to ashes).
